_comment: Tracks real, popularity-weighted OSS Terraform/OpenTofu estates run through the five-stage crossing pipeline (cold deploy -> migrate -> test plan -> test apply -> drift and reconverge), same spirit as cohort-acceptance.json but for real-world estates rather than estate-gen's synthetic cohorts. A stage is 'pass', 'fail', or 'not_run' - not_run means the estate's script does not yet exercise that stage, which is itself a gap worth closing, not a silent pass. Updated by the orchestrator from each crossing's own verified run, not by an agent editing this file directly - the same discipline live/cohort-acceptance.json uses, so N concurrent crossings never fight over one JSON file's sort order.

estates.source: hand-written reference project: the plainest getting-started shape (VPC/subnet/SG/IGW/EC2)
estates.notes: Verified end-to-end 2026-08-17/18. Predates the drift-and-reconverge stage being added to the pipeline shape; needs a follow-up pass to add it, same as every other pre-existing corpus-* script.
